seed.welcomeDoc:
This is your first doc. Type `/` to insert headings, lists, checklists, tables or images.

## How everything connects

- **Meetings:** connect Google Calendar in Settings. In any meeting, tap *Take notes* and a doc is created with the date and attendees.
- **Action items into tasks:** write a checklist in any doc and use *Convert checklist to tasks*.
- **Claude sessions:** use *Import Markdown* or create a token in Settings, API, so Claude can save documentation right here.

## Shortcuts

- `C` creates a task from any screen
- `⌘K` searches tasks, docs and workspaces

- [ ] Connect Google Calendar
- [ ] Invite your team
- [ ] Create the project's first doc

welcome.title: Welcome to Veltro
welcome.body: Veltro brings together your meetings, what gets decided in them and your team's tasks, so every meeting turns into work done. In one minute we'll show you where everything is.

ask.title: Ask Veltro
ask.body: Type whatever you need to know: what's due this week, what was decided in a meeting or what someone has blocked. It answers with your own tasks, decisions and docs.

counters.title: Your day at a glance
counters.body: What's overdue, due today, in progress or blocked. Tap any number to see those tasks.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.body: Each project, client or department is a space, with its own tasks, docs and meetings. Yours are here; use the arrow to open their sections.

meetings.title: Meetings that lead somewhere
meetings.body: Your Google Calendar, inside Veltro. Every meeting has its own room: you prepare the agenda, capture notes while you talk and when you close it Veltro creates the tasks, the summary and the follow-up email.

notation.title: Write the way you talk
notation.body: In a meeting room, each line starts with a sign that says what it is. @ marks the owner and “tomorrow” or “friday” sets the date. Try changing the sign or the text:

tasks.title: All your tasks
tasks.body: From all your spaces as a list, table, board or calendar, with filters. If you lead a team, you also see your people's tasks.

mesa.title: Control room
mesa.body: For team leads: how each space is doing, whether the team is moving forward and who is overloaded, without asking for a report.

vault.title: Vault
vault.body: All of the account's files and links, with titles and tags, linked to a space, a task or a meeting, or on their own.

pasillo.title: Hallway
pasillo.body: Your team's chats and groups. Share tasks, files or invites, or start a Meet right away.

search.title: Everything with ⌘K
search.body: Search tasks, docs, files or chats, or type a command. Press ? to see every shortcut.

notation.label: Try the notation
notation.question: question
notation.hint: Start the line with one of the signs above.
